notes.title: Making the game simpler!
notes.content:
The general consensus amongst players has been that the game was too hard and unforgiving, therefore in this update, the game is made much simpler and smoother.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated rover physics to give the wheels much more grip (this should make it much easier to traverse the terrain)
[*] Significantly more checkpoints throughout the game
[*] Removed several obstacles across all levels
[/list]

notes.title: Major Rework
notes.content:
Following feedback from players post launch, the game has been significantly reworked to address player's main concerns of having to continuously go back on yourself throughout the game. All levels have been reworked to accomplish this, as well as updating the story where appropriate.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked all levels so you no longer have to go back on yourself continuously
[*] Redesigned act 3 and minorly updated story​
[*] Minor changes to credits and post credits scene
[*] Updated default key binds
[*] Buff rover speed
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]
